there are some 3rd party apps for this purpose, but its very basic thing, that should be included in this phone.
4. There is no call recorder option available!
5. You can't turn on Wifi and hotspot together.
6. Also, there is no quad flash and front cam flash.
7. No charger included.

Anyways, performance wise its best. can handle multi tasking and normal games as well...

Well, this phone might lack some features, but its budget phone overall.
